youngster.name: Boy
dialog: That grand house is the Pokémon Mansion. Its owner is ever so rich, and ever so proud of it.
Behind it is the Trophy Garden. Rare Pokémon turn up there every now and then!

collector.name: Collector
dialog: Enjoy the sunshine while it lasts.
Further down this road it turns to rain, and it stays wet all the way to Pastoria City.

trainer.name: Jason
trainer.dialogueBefore: Rich Boy Jason: My Prinplup has its own pool and its own coach. Can your Pokémon say the same?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Rich Boy Jason: Clearly I'll need to hire a better coach.

trainer.name: Melissa
trainer.dialogueBefore: Lady Melissa: Oh, a visitor! Shall we have a little battle while the tea is brewing?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Lady Melissa: Goodness me. The tea has gone quite cold.

trainer.name: Jeremy
trainer.dialogueBefore: Gentleman Jeremy: My Chatot repeats everything it hears, so do mind your language while we battle.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Gentleman Jeremy: Chatot, I beg you, don't repeat what I just said.

trainer.name: Reina
trainer.dialogueBefore: Socialite Reina: A battle, darling? How wonderfully unexpected! Roselia, do the honours.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Socialite Reina: How simply dreadful. I must sit down.

trainer.name: Bobby
trainer.dialogueBefore: Policeman Bobby: Stop right there! I'll have to see what your Pokémon are made of.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Policeman Bobby: Very good. Carry on, and stay out of trouble.

trainer.name: Alex
trainer.dialogueBefore: Policeman Alex: I keep watch over the mansion. Nobody walks past me without a battle!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Policeman Alex: You may pass. Keep to the road, please.

trainer.name: Dylan
trainer.dialogueBefore: Policeman Dylan: Up and down, up and down, all shift long. At last, something happens!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Policeman Dylan: Right. Back to walking up and down.

trainer.name: Caleb
trainer.dialogueBefore: Policeman Caleb: Hold it! I'll need to see your Trainer Card. And your Pokémon, in battle.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Policeman Caleb: Everything seems to be in order. On your way.

Route 212
North: Hearthome City
South: Pastoria City
signs.signboard_pokemon_mansion:
Pokémon Mansion
A grand house, with a garden of rare Pokémon behind it.
signs.trainer_tips_signpost:
Trainer Tips
Give your Pokémon a Berry to hold. In battle it will eat it all by itself when the time is right!
